# from_faiss { #dyf.from_faiss }

```python
from_faiss(
    faiss_index,
    path,
    compression='zstd',
    quantization='float16',
    metadata=None,
    stored_fields=None,
)
```

Build a dyf lazy index file from a FAISS IVF index.

Extracts FAISS's inverted lists and centroids, builds a single-level
dyf tree (one node per IVF cell), and writes to the dyf file format.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                                                                                                | Description                                                                             | Default     |
|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| faiss_index   |                                                                                                                     | A trained faiss.IndexIVFFlat or faiss.IndexIVFPQ.                                       | _required_  |
| path          | [str](`str`)                                                                                                        | Output file path (e.g., "index.dyf").                                                   | _required_  |
| compression   | [str](`str`)                                                                                                        | "none", "zstd", or "lz4" (default: "none").                                             | `'zstd'`    |
| quantization  | [str](`str`)                                                                                                        | "float32", "float16", or "int8" (default: "float16").                                   | `'float16'` |
| metadata      | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\] \| None                                                                | Optional dict of string key-value pairs.                                                | `None`      |
| stored_fields | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [StoredFieldInput](`dyf.lazy_index.StoredFieldInput`)\] \| None | Optional dict mapping field name to array-like of length n_items (indexed by FAISS ID). | `None`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                    | Description                           |
|--------|-----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
|        | [LazyIndex](`dyf.lazy_index.LazyIndex`) | LazyIndex opened on the written file. |
